description: Run a sandboxed executable in the workspace using direct argv semantics. Shell operators such as ;, |, &&, globbing, and redirection are not implicit; use command=sh with args=["-lc", "..."] when shell syntax is required. Supports scripts, builds, package managers, Git, and interpreters. Returns stdout, stderr, and exit status.
name: terminal_exec
title: Sandboxed Coding Terminal

description: Make an HTTP(S) request and return the response; methods may mutate remote state.
name: http_fetch
title: HTTP Fetch

description: Search the web through the configured SearxNG backend and return matching results.
name: web_search
title: Web Search

description: List a workspace directory with deterministic ordering, bounded recursion, entry types, and explicit truncation without following symlink directories.
name: directory_list
title: Directory List

description: Search regular workspace files using a bounded glob subset (*, ?, and ** path segments) with deterministic cwd-relative results. Hidden files are searchable; .git, node_modules, target, .nuxt, and .output directories are skipped; symlinks observed during traversal are not followed recursively. On Linux, descendant traversal uses stable directory descriptors with no-follow opens. Native entries whose names are not valid UTF-8 are omitted from JSON results.
name: file_search
title: File Search

description: Atomically create or explicitly overwrite a contained UTF-8 text file. overwrite=false and create_parents=false are the defaults. Parent traversal uses no-follow directory descriptors; symlinked parents/final targets and root escapes are rejected. New files use mode 0644; overwrites preserve existing permissions.
name: file_write
title: File Write

description: Atomically replace an exact UTF-8 text occurrence in an existing contained regular file. By default exactly one match is required; replace_all=true replaces every match. Final symlinks, ambiguous matches, stale entry identity, oversized content, and root escapes fail before commit.
name: file_edit
title: File Edit

description: Read a contained UTF-8 text file using 1-based line ranges with hard line/byte bounds and explicit truncation. Directories, invalid UTF-8, external symlink targets, oversized lines, and out-of-root paths are rejected.
name: file_read
title: File Read

description: Search workspace text with ripgrep using direct argv in a read-only execution-root sandbox. Defaults to literal, case-sensitive matching; regex=true enables regex syntax. Ripgrep's normal hidden/ignore behavior applies, symlinks are not followed, previews and total results are server-bounded.
name: text_search
title: Text Search

description: Inspect bounded structured repository status without invoking user Git helpers.
name: git_status
title: Git Status

description: Read a bounded Git diff with external diff and textconv disabled; continuation is signed and bound to the repository and diff query.
name: git_diff
title: Git Diff

description: Read bounded commit metadata from repository history.
name: git_log
title: Git Log

description: Read bounded commit/object presentation with executable diff helpers disabled; continuation is signed and bound to the resolved object.
name: git_show
title: Git Show

description: Read bounded line-to-commit mappings for one contained repository file.
name: git_blame
title: Git Blame

description: List bounded local branch identities and current/upstream facts without invoking user Git helpers.
name: git_branch_list
title: Git Branch List

description: Create one validated local branch at HEAD or an explicit contained commit start point without switching the worktree.
name: git_branch_create
title: Git Branch Create

description: Switch to one existing validated local branch without force, detach, remote guessing, or carrying a dirty worktree.
name: git_branch_switch
title: Git Branch Switch

description: Stage an explicit bounded set of contained repository file paths; protected paths and unsafe symlinks are denied.
name: git_stage
title: Git Stage

description: Unstage an explicit bounded set of contained repository file paths without changing worktree content.
name: git_unstage
title: Git Unstage

description: Create one local commit from the already-staged index using bounded message input and repository-local identity only; user hooks and global Git config remain disabled.
name: git_commit
title: Git Commit

description: Inspect bounded structured merge/rebase state and conflicted paths for the contained repository.
name: git_operation_status
title: Git Operation Status

description: Start a bounded local no-ff merge from a validated commit ref; conflicts are returned through structured operation state.
name: git_merge_start
title: Git Merge Start

description: Continue an active merge only after all conflicts are resolved and staged.
name: git_merge_continue
title: Git Merge Continue

description: Abort the active contained-repository merge operation.
name: git_merge_abort
title: Git Merge Abort

description: Start a bounded local rebase onto a validated commit ref; conflicts are returned through structured operation state.
name: git_rebase_start
title: Git Rebase Start

description: Continue an active rebase only after all conflicts are resolved and staged.
name: git_rebase_continue
title: Git Rebase Continue

description: Abort the active contained-repository rebase operation.
name: git_rebase_abort
title: Git Rebase Abort

description: Delete one non-current local branch using Git's merged-state safety check; force deletion is unavailable.
name: git_branch_delete
title: Git Branch Delete

description: Apply a constrained unified text patch to existing contained regular files. All targets and hunks are preflighted; symlinks, protected paths, stale context, adds/deletes/renames, binary content, and root escapes fail closed. dry_run validates without mutation; commit uses atomic per-file replacement with best-effort rollback if a later file fails.
name: apply_patch
title: Apply Patch

description: Bounded document symbols for one contained source file, or workspace symbol search when a query is given (only if the language server advertises workspace-symbol support). Language is inferred from the file extension / project markers; never both path and query ambiguity.
name: code_symbols
title: Code Symbols

description: Bounded, contained definition locations for a symbol at a UTF-8 file position, using real language-server semantics.
name: code_definition
title: Code Definition

description: Bounded, contained reference locations for a symbol at a UTF-8 file position.
name: code_references
title: Code References

description: Bounded, contained implementation locations for a symbol at a UTF-8 file position. Capability-gated: returns a distinct unsupported-capability error when the language server does not advertise implementation search.
name: code_implementations
title: Code Implementations

description: Bounded plain/markdown hover (type/docs) text for a symbol at a UTF-8 file position. Server-provided markdown is treated as inert text, never rendered as executable HTML.
name: code_hover
title: Code Hover

description: Bounded normalized diagnostics for one contained source file, including severity, stable diagnostic code when available, source, and document version (when the server reports one), so a stale result can be detected.
name: code_diagnostics
title: Code Diagnostics

description: Preview-only bounded rename: normalizes the language server's WorkspaceEdit into per-file text replacements without applying anything. Apply the result yourself through apply_patch/file_edit after review. Rejects edits outside the contained workspace, protected paths, unsafe symlinks, and any unsupported resource operation (file create/rename/delete).
name: code_rename_preview
title: Code Rename Preview

description: Start a bounded sandboxed terminal job and return its task ID for polling.
name: terminal_job_start
title: Start Terminal Job

description: Get bounded state and retained output for a terminal job.
name: terminal_job_get
title: Get Terminal Job

description: Cancel a running terminal job and its process group.
name: terminal_job_cancel
title: Cancel Terminal Job
